transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm just... I don't know. I'm here because I don't really care about anything anymore. I used to do things. Art classes... board-game nights. I liked hiking. I was supposed to get back to playing soccer, but... I just don't care. I just sit in my room. Everything is just sort of... slipping away.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... a while. Almost two years. I guess it started... right after the divorce. So, about a year and eleven months now.
Have you ever had a period when your mood was unusually elevated or irritable compared with your usual self?
No... I don't think so. I don't really get excited or... elevated. It's mostly just... the same. Just low.
During these almost two years, have there been distinct periods when your mood and functioning became much worse than usual?

I don't know about... distinct periods. It's mostly just been all the time. 

Since this all started, I haven't just been... scared or confused by things. I've mostly just been really depressed. I barely care about anything anymore. It just feels like... like my life is already over. So... yeah. Just most of the time.
How has your sleep been since this started?

Not great. I mostly just... lie awake for hours. Just listening. Checking the door. And then... when I finally do sleep, I wake up way before dawn. Usually shaking. And I just... I can't get back under. So I don't sleep much.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy?

Yeah... I'm tired all the time. I don't really do much... I might just stay in bed for half the day. But even then... if I just have to take a shower or... or reply to a text from someone... it feels like I just worked a whole shift or something. It's just... too much.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions since this started?
I don't know. I guess... maybe? I just... I don't really do much that takes concentration anyway. So... I'm not sure.
Since this began, has there been any period lasting two months or more when you felt mostly back to your usual self?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt like myself in... I don't know how long. It's just been like this.
Have you had thoughts about killing yourself or ending your life?

I... yeah. I just... I keep thinking I don't want to wake up anymore. It's just... I guess my friend found me the other day, and... she said I was just saying out loud that I couldn't keep living like this. I don't know.
Have you thought about a specific way you might kill yourself?
No... not really. I don't... I haven't figured anything out like that. I just... mostly I just want it to be over.
Since this began, have you noticed any change in your appetite?
Yeah... I guess. I just go most of the day without eating. It's... I don't know, food just tastes like cardboard anyway. My jeans have gotten pretty loose... I have to knot the waistband now.
Have other people noticed that you are moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?

I don't really know what other people notice. I guess... sometimes I just pace. Like, from the kitchen to the window, over and over until my legs ache. But then... other days, I just can't. Everything is just... slow. Even just trying to make coffee feels like I'm lifting wet cement. I don't know.
In the past two weeks, have your depression symptoms been noticeably worse than they were during most of the preceding two years?
I don't know. It's just... always bad. I haven't really kept track of time like that. It just feels the same. Heavy.
How much have these symptoms interfered with your ability to manage your daily responsibilities, such as work, school, or basic self-care?

I guess... a lot. I haven't been taking any of my freelance art stuff. I just... can't. I don't go to community events anymore, or play soccer. My friend... she has to come over a lot. Just to make sure I'm okay. Like... making sure I eat something, or shower. Sometimes she just stays because... I don't know, it's probably better I'm not by myself right now.
Have there been any stretches of at least two months during these past two years when you had no significant depression or loss of interest?
No. Not really. I don't think there's ever been a time like that. It's just... always there.
Over the past two years, has there been a period lasting at least two weeks when your depression was clearly worse than your usual baseline?
I'm not really sure. It's... it's hard to tell if it ever gets worse than usual. It all just kind of feels the same to me.
Was there ever a clear stretch of at least two weeks when your depression was noticeably worse than your usual long-term level?
I... like I just said, I really don't know. I don't keep track of the weeks like that. It's just... heavy, all the time. I can't really pick out a specific time it was worse.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt depressed or uninterested in things nearly every day?

Yeah... I guess so. Most days I just... I wake up and there's this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It just feels like... like there's no future for me outside of my apartment. It's just always there.
During the past two weeks, have you felt that these depressive symptoms were severe enough to prevent you from carrying out most of your usual daily activities?

Yeah... I don't really do much of anything anymore. I haven't taken any of my freelance art stuff in a while. And I don't go to community things or play soccer anymore. My friend has to come over and check on me... just to make sure I eat or take a shower. I just... can't do it on my own right now.
In the past two weeks, have you had trouble concentrating nearly every day?
I don't... I haven't really noticed. I'm not doing anything that takes focus anyway, so... I wouldn't really know.
